svg.title: Neural-QR — proposed header-free optical layout
svg.desc: Illustrative 32 by 32 color symbol grid, rectified to 64 by 64 RGB pixels at 2 by 2 pixels per cell, with known grid-8 references, static black and white finders at four corners, a handed asymmetric bottom-right finder, fixed sixteen-color references on both sides, and repeated phase-2 color cue pairs above and below the payload. Four example phase cue pairs are shown below. Payload values are random illustration, not an encoded or scannable packet.

g.text: Header-free acquisition • neural symbol recovery • in-band packet metadata
Sixteen ordered colors on both sides.
Color cells carry data, packet fields,
Same layout concept at different sizes;
palette indices (p, (p + 1) mod 4), independent of data permutation
Diagram only: sample symbols, no encoded packet. Neural-QR is a custom format, not standard QR.
Neural Cryptography · Alejandro Hernandez Ruiz (magnux) · Apache-2.0
